business_summary: Raymond James Financial, Inc., a diversified financial services company, provides private client group, capital markets, asset management, banking, and other services to individuals, corporations, and municipalities in the United States, Canada, and Europe. The Private Client Group segment offers financial planning, investment advisory, securities transaction, investment services, portfolio management services, insurance and annuity products, and mutual funds; support to third-party mutual fund and annuity companies, including sales and marketing support, as well as distribution and accounting, and administrative services; margin loans; securities borrowing and lending services; and custodial, trade execution, research, and other support and services. The Capital Markets segment provides investment banking services, such as equity and debt underwriting, and merger and acquisition advisory; and fixed income and equity brokerage services. This segment also offers institutional sales, securities trading, equity research, and the syndication and management of investments in low-income housing funds and funds of a similar nature. The Asset Management segment provides asset management, portfolio management, and related administrative services to retail and institutional clients; and administrative support services, such as record-keeping. The Bank segment offers various types of loans, including securities-based, corporate, commercial and industrial, commercial real estate and construction, real estate investment trust, residential mortgage, and tax-exempt loans; Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation-insured deposit accounts; retail and corporate deposit; and liquidity management products and services. The Other segment engages in the private equity investments comprising investments in third-party funds. The company offers corporate, retail banking and trust services. Raymond James Financial, Inc. was founded in 1962 and is headquartered in Saint Petersburg, Florida.
business_summary_ko: 다양한 금융 서비스 회사인 Raymond James Financial, Inc.는 미국, 캐나다 및 유럽의 개인, 기업 및 지방 자치 단체에 개인 고객 그룹, 자본 시장, 자산 관리, 은행 및 기타 서비스를 제공합니다. 개인 고객 그룹 부문은 재무 계획, 투자 자문, 증권 거래, 투자 서비스, 포트폴리오 관리 서비스, 보험 및 연금 상품, 뮤추얼 펀드를 제공합니다. 판매 및 마케팅 지원은 물론 유통 및 회계, 관리 서비스를 포함한 제3자 뮤추얼 펀드 및 연금 회사에 대한 지원 마진 대출; 증권 대출 및 대출 서비스; 보관, 거래 집행, 연구, 기타 지원 및 서비스. 자본 시장 부문은 주식 및 부채 인수, 인수 합병 자문과 같은 투자 은행 서비스를 제공합니다. 고정 수입 및 주식 중개 서비스. 이 부문은 또한 기관 판매, 증권 거래, 주식 조사, 저소득 주택 펀드 및 유사한 성격의 펀드에 대한 투자 신디케이션 및 관리를 제공합니다. 자산 관리 부문은 자산 관리를 제공합니다.
